description: Get Gene Ontology (GO) annotations for a yeast (S. cerevisiae) gene/locus from SGD (Saccharomyces Genome Database). Accepts a systematic name (e.g. YAL001C), a standard gene name (e.g. TFC3), or an SGDID (e.g. S000000001). Returns GO terms with their GO id, aspect (molecular function / biological process / cellular component), and supporting evidence. Keyless.

id.description: Systematic name (YAL001C), gene name (TFC3), or SGDID (S000000001).
